gnotobiotics

Gnotobiotics and the Innovive Research- Ready IVC System

As microbiome research grows, maintaining gnotobiotic rodents in a germ-free setting is crucial. Traditionally, isolators have been the standard, but emerging studies support the use of IVC caging, especially disposable IVC caging, for effective germ-free maintenance

Explore IVC System

Why Use a Research-Ready IVC System for Gnotobiotic Research?

Research-Ready cages arrive irradiated, double-bagged, and are guaranteed to have never housed another rodent. This ensures aseptic conditions at the cage level from the very beginning, eliminating the possibility of germs being left behind from the cleaning process. Simply put, you start with a clean, germ free cage at every change

Benefits

Key Benefits

Key Benefits of the Research-Ready IVC System for Gnotobiotics

Immediate Usability

Our Research-Ready Cages Come

  • Double-bagged and irradiated
  • Ready to be used immediately upon arrival, or stored until needed
  • Options for pre-bedding, pre-filled water bottles, and enrichment
Biosecurity

Our System is engineered for optimal biosecurity, featuring

  • Dual HEPA filters at both the rack and cage level (with use of the MVX3 lid)
  • Racks with adjustable settings for positive and negative airflow
  • Cage lids that create an airtight seal

Get in Touch!

We're always happy to hear from you. Whether you're interested in our products, services, partnerships, or just want to learn more about us, please fill out the contact form. We appreciate your interest and look forward to connecting with you! Contact Us THREE PILLARS

How the Research-Ready System Enhances Your Gnotobiotic Research

With advanced airflow and filtration systems, our IVC racks and cages ensure maximum control over environmental conditions

Aseptic Setup

The irradiated and double-bagged cages ensure that no external contaminants are introduced into your research environment

Efficiency & Scalability

As your gnotobiotic program expands, the flexible ordering process allows for easy scaling without additional investments
